basic_info.description: Welcome to 3879 17th Street, a gorgeously renovated Italianate flat in prime Eureka Valley/Castro! This top-floor condo blends 19th-century charm with dazzling modern updates. The home's inviting living room features coved ceilings, an ornate fireplace, and a bay window overlooking tree-lined 17th Street. Just down the hallway, the formal dining room features decorative wainscoting, a built-in glass-faced hutch, and can accommodate larger dining tables. The newly renovated sunlit kitchen boasts gorgeous veined marble counters, sleek flat-panel cabinetry, and premium stainless appliances, including a 5-burner Bertazzoni gas range, Fisher & Paykel refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, and ventilation hood. A bright breakfast room opens to the private deck with sweeping views to Liberty Hill, perfect for casual dining and/or a home office. An adjacent laundry room houses full-sized LG washer & dryer. Two spacious bedrooms offer high ceilings, natural light, and original trim. The updated bath features a clawfoot tub, subway tile, and hex mosaic floors. Period details throughout and gallery-style lighting. Enjoy a shared garden oasis and close proximity to Mission Dolores, the Castro, Duboce Triangle, and Valencia Corridor amenities. 1-car leased parking a few doors down in private garage.
